author: EadraZxZ
quote: 30 FPS and a boyfriend simulator? Not even a good one at that. Why would I want to waste my time being bossed around by a girl who didn't even tell me I had a kid? What a, C***! This is the most undesirable woman I've ever come across. Besides, I play games to get away from life, not reenact it. Watching TV, going to the grocery store, painting? Yeah, I do that already. Let's make a game where I have to do that again. WTF? This sounds like a game that was written by women who fantasize about the ultimate beta guy. Not becoming a crime lord. What a waste of time and money, never pre-ordering again.
